checkpoints.description: [1/2] Plan and add lossless WAV concatenation

impact_assessment.why: crossfade overlaps files and repeat-wav tiles one file, but there is no way to append several different WAVs losslessly.
impact_assessment.benefits: concat-wav appends the frames of two or more matching-rate WAVs byte-for-byte, preserving sample rate and length sum; a single input is an identity.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: rates must match, frames appended in order, no overlap or gain change, single input identity, invalid WAVs fail; dependency: std only; concurrency: none; state: none.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Add byte-vector tests for ordered concatenation, exact frames, rate check and single-input identity, a multi-WAV CLI command, then run cargo gates and aikit check --strict.

checkpoints.description: 5/5 AIKit gates passed; 465 tests green; ordered appending, exact frames and single-input identity pinned by byte tests
Task 'coda-concat-wav' completed successfully.

checkpoints.description: [1/2] Plan and add WAV region overwrite

impact_assessment.why: splice inserts and shifts the tail, but there is no way to replace a region of a WAV in place while keeping its exact length.
impact_assessment.benefits: overwrite replaces frames from a chosen time with another WAV's audio, clamping to the base length and leaving the head and tail untouched.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: rates must match, at non-negative and rounded to frames, base length preserved, regions beyond the end are no-ops, invalid WAVs fail; dependency: std only; concurrency: none; state: none.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Add byte-vector tests for in-place replacement, head/tail preservation, length and rate validation, a two-WAV CLI command reusing --at, then run cargo gates and aikit check --strict.

checkpoints.description: 5/5 AIKit gates passed; 470 tests green; in-place replacement, length preservation and truncation pinned by byte tests
Task 'coda-overwrite' completed successfully.

checkpoints.description: [1/2] Plan and add a localized tuplet transform

impact_assessment.why: stretch scales a whole score and augment scales durations globally, with no way to compress or expand only a beat window into a tuplet.
impact_assessment.benefits: tuplets remaps note times inside [start,end) by a ratio, leaving notes outside untouched and preserving pitch, velocity and timbre.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: 0 <= start < end, ratio positive finite, notes outside window unchanged, inside times and durations scaled, round-trip, invalid values fail; dependency: std only; concurrency: none; state: none.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Add byte-vector tests for window remapping, outside-note preservation and round-trip, a CLI command with --start/--end/--tuplet-ratio, then run cargo gates and aikit check --strict.

checkpoints.description: 5/5 AIKit gates passed; 475 tests green; window compression, outside shifting and round-trip pinned by byte tests
Task 'coda-tuplets' completed successfully.
checkpoints.head: 5ba6a57ed1a54888d9026563103e424c40625dfa

checkpoints.description: [1/2] Plan and add velocity quantization to a level grid

impact_assessment.why: velocity tools scale or ramp values, but there is no way to snap a score's velocities to a small set of discrete dynamic levels.
impact_assessment.benefits: velgrid snaps sounding-note velocities to the nearest of N evenly spaced levels with lower-on-tie, leaving rests and all other fields untouched.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: levels >=2, nearest level exact, lower on ties, rests unchanged, round-trip, invalid values fail; dependency: std only; concurrency: none; state: none.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Add byte-vector tests for snapping, ties, rest handling and round-trip, a CLI command with --levels, then run cargo gates and aikit check --strict.

checkpoints.description: 5/5 AIKit gates passed; 480 tests green; nearest-level snapping, tie-breaking and rest handling pinned by byte tests
Task 'coda-velgrid' completed successfully.

checkpoints.description: [1/2] Plan and add rolling peak-envelope extraction for WAVs

impact_assessment.why: analysis reports peak and RMS but there is no way to turn a signal's amplitude contour into audio for visualization or follow-up processing.
impact_assessment.benefits: envelope renders a causal rolling peak per channel over a window in frames; window 1 is byte-identical and output stays bounded.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: window >=1, causal trailing window, window 1 identity, length and rate preserved, deterministic, invalid WAVs fail; dependency: std only; concurrency: none; state: none.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Add byte-vector tests for identity, constant-signal contour, silence and bounds, a CLI command with --window, then run cargo gates and aikit check --strict.

checkpoints.description: 5/5 AIKit gates passed; 485 tests green; causal contour, window-one identity and bounds pinned by byte tests
Task 'coda-envelope-wav' completed successfully.

checkpoints.description: [1/2] Plan and add register solo for scores

impact_assessment.why: snap-scale moves pitches into a range but no tool extracts only the notes already inside a chosen pitch range.
impact_assessment.benefits: solo keeps only sounding notes whose pitch lies within [low, high], dropping rests and out-of-range notes while preserving all kept fields.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: bounds must parse with low <= high, in-range notes kept unchanged, out-of-range and rests removed, round-trip, invalid values fail; dependency: std only; concurrency: none; state: none.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Add byte-vector tests for in/out filtering, rest removal and round-trip, a CLI command reusing --low/--high, then run cargo gates and aikit check --strict.

checkpoints.description: 5/5 AIKit gates passed; 490 tests green; range filtering, rest removal and round-trip pinned by byte tests
Task 'coda-solo' completed successfully.

checkpoints.description: [1/2] Plan and add a ping-pong delay for WAVs

impact_assessment.why: echo-to feeds back into the same channels, with no way to bounce an echo alternately between left and right.
impact_assessment.benefits: pingpong alternates delayed echoes across channels with decaying feedback, deterministic and byte-identical at zero delay.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: delay non-negative and rounded to frames, feedback 0..1 clamped below 1, zero delay identity, bounded, deterministic, invalid WAVs fail; dependency: std only; concurrency: none; state: none.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Add byte-vector tests for identity, alternating tails, bounds and determinism, a CLI command with --ping-delay/--ping-feedback, then run cargo gates and aikit check --strict.

checkpoints.description: 5/5 AIKit gates passed; 495 tests green; zero-delay identity, alternating tails and bounds pinned by byte tests
